scope: Selected manually reviewed screensaver-only images from an earlier owner-approved native-TV experiment; not evidence of a live installation of the public optional module.

detail_processing.processing: crop only; no resampling or brightness/gamma/contrast/color adjustment

selection: Eight original-animation frames were sampled; a clearly visible colorful burst was selected. Original and replacement are different animation moments, not synchronized photometry.
privacy_review: No playback, recommendations, account, host, LAN, MAC or serial data visible. Native Finnish wake-up hint remains in the original screenshot.
